classification.difficultyReason: Combine three successive growth multipliers and express the combined effect as a percentage increase.

content.prompt: The population of a country increased by $3\%$, $2.6\%$ and $1.8\%$ in three successive years. What was the total percentage increase in the country’s population over the three-year period? Give your answer to 2 decimal places.

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}\text{Combined multiplier}&=1.03\times1.026\times1.018\\\text{Combined multiplier}&=1.07580204\\\text{Total percentage increase}&=(1.07580204-1)\times100\%\\\text{Total percentage increase}&=7.580204\%\\\text{Total percentage increase}&\approx7.58\%\end{align*}$$
